<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      7 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.

         **Review examples:**

            3. _TerriJo_, Sep 6, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve subscribed to MyFitnessPal Premium intermittently for years, and I’ve always come back because the core tracking tools are solid. But this time has been incredibly frustrating.I purchased MFP Premium in February 2026 and the subscription still shows as active in my Apple Subscriptions list. Despite that, the app refuses to recognize it — Premium features are locked, Restore Purchase is missing, and Manage Subscription doesn’t appear anywhere.I contacted MyFitnessPal support about this problem back in May, provided screenshots, and followed every step they suggested. Months later, nothing has been resolved. Apple says the issue is with the app, and the app says nothing helpful at all.After years of being a paying customer, it’s disappointing to hit a subscription entitlement failure that neither Apple nor MFP seems willing or able to fix. I hope the developers take this seriously, because long‑time users shouldn’t have to fight this hard just to access a subscription they already paid for."
